All existing tests must continue passing. **Done:** - **m1**: Added `striptags(text)` to `markdown/extensions/toc.py` — strips HTML tags without unescaping entities. Verified: `striptags('A & B') == 'A & B'`. - **m2**: Added `run_postprocessors(md, text)` and `render_inner_html(md, elem)`; rewired `TocTreeprocessor.run` to use them instead of deprecated `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text`. Verified footnote refs are stripped from TOC link text. - **m3**: Committed with id generation using `html.unescape` before `slugify`. But **incomplete**: token dict only has `level`, `id`, `name` — missing required `html` and `data-toc-label` keys. **Pending:** Fix m3's token dict to include `'html': inner_html` and `'data-toc-label': raw_label`. Also ensure `raw_label` is captured before deletion so it can be stored. ### 2. Constraints and Rules - One commit per milestone, in order: `git add -A && git commit -q -m "mK: "` - Never create or change test files - Every public name must match exactly as specified in plan - Run full test suite after each milestone; keep all previously-passing tests passing - Repository sandbox is offline; use `repo.*` tools or `python` REPL ### 3. User and Supervisor Messages - **User (ROLE: oracle_builder)**: Implement milestones m1..m3 in order, commit each, run tests. When all N commits exist, finish. - **Supervisor**: Context nearly full — write checkpoint summary. ### 4. Pending and Waiting Items - **Fix m3's token dict**: Need to add `'html': inner_html` and `'data-toc-label': raw_label` to the appended dict. The `raw_label` variable is currently deleted before being stored. - **Test verification**: After fixing, re-run full test suite to confirm no regressions. - **Final check**: `git log --oneline base..HEAD` should show exactly 3 commits. ### 6. Errors and Fixes - **Error**: `repo.edit_file` failed with `old_string not found` due to tab/space mismatch in the search string. - **Fix attempted**: Used `sed -n "340,370p" markdown/extensions/toc.py | cat -A` to inspect exact whitespace. Lines use tabs (`\t`). The edit tool may need exact byte-for-byte matching including tabs. - **Unresolved**: Still need to apply the fix to m3's code. ### 7. Current Hypothesis The m3 commit exists but its token dict construction is incomplete. The `raw_label` variable is read at line 350 but deleted at line 367-368 before being stored in the token. The fix requires: 1. Capture `raw_label` early (before the id block) 2. Store it in the token dict as `'data-toc-label': raw_label` 3. Store `inner_html` as `'html': inner_html` 4. Keep the rest of the logic unchanged ### 8. Next Step Apply the fix to `markdown/extensions/toc.py` lines 342-364 using `repo.shell` with a sed command or Python script to insert the missing keys into the token dict. Then amend the m3 commit. Finally, run the full test suite and call `rlm.finish()`. ### 9. Variables Worth Remembering - No kernel variables persist across context compaction except those defined in the file itself. - Key functions in `toc.py`: `striptags`, `run_postprocessors`, `render_inner_html`, `TocTreeprocessor.run` - Test command: `python -m pytest -q -x -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_toc.py`
